About Us


Our mission is simple: we want to set people free to do meaningful work. People love our software--and it turns out that people love working here too. We’ve been recognized as a “Best Company to Work For”, and we’re proud of our team for receiving awards for workplace effectiveness and flexibility.


What You'll Do


Our ideal Sr. Software Engineer/Developer (with experience in PHP, Perl, Python or Ruby) will be an integral contributor to the current and next generation of our APP.  You'll be working on multiple projects to continue making us the #1 HR Software for SMB business.  If you get a kick out of solving problems and building beautiful world class software
